x: During the Second World War, in protest against Britain's inclusion of India in the war without Indian consent, Congress ministers resigned in October 1939 AD. Subsequently, the 53rd session of the Congress was held in March 1940 AD at Ramgarh (present-day Jharkhand), presided over by Maulana Abul Kalam Azad. In August 1940 AD, the British government introduced the "August Offer" (or Linlithgow offer) to seek Indian support for the war. Later, in 1942 AD, the Cripps Mission was sent to India. This mission proposed limited self-governance for India and was part of a series of efforts to secure Indian cooperation in the war effort.
